mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses c WHERE

SELECT c.id, c.title, c.course_kind, c.user_id, u.nickname, (u.status = 'DEACTIVATED') AS writer_withdrawn, c.views, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_days day WHERE day.course_id = c.id) AS day_count,
AS representative_image_url FROM courses c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE ORDER BY c.views DESC, c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT membership.course_id, country.region_name AS country_name FROM course_countries membership JOIN country_categories country ON country.id = membership.country_id WHERE membership.course_id IN #{courseId} ORDER BY membership.course_id, membership.display_order

WITH RECURSIVE region_paths AS ( SELECT stop.course_id, stop.day_number, stop.display_order, stop.stop_id, region.id AS region_id, region.parent_id, region.code AS region_code, region.region_name FROM () stop JOIN destinations destination ON destination.id = stop.destination_id JOIN country_categories region ON region.id = destination.region_id WHERE stop.course_id IN #{courseId}
UNION ALL
SELECT path.course_id, path.day_number, path.display_order, path.stop_id, parent.id, parent.parent_id, parent.code, parent.region_name FROM region_paths path JOIN country_categories parent ON parent.id = path.parent_id )
SELECT path.course_id, path.stop_id, path.region_id, path.parent_id, path.region_code, path.region_name, CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(path.region_code), '') IS NOT NULL AND path.region_code NOT LIKE '%-%' AND ( (path.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND ancestor_parent.id IS NOT NULL AND ancestor_parent.parent_id IS NULL) OR ( path.parent_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM country_categories country_child WHERE country_child.parent_id = path.region_id AND country_child.code LIKE CONCAT(path.region_code, '-%') ) ) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS country_node FROM region_paths path LEFT JOIN country_categories ancestor_parent ON ancestor_parent.id = path.parent_id ORDER BY course_id, day_number, display_order, stop_id
